shots.state: the screen as he saw it (his own screenshot)

key.flag: On a computer, the names in the top navigation break onto two lines each, so the header looks cramped and uneven.
key.his_words: the text is weird on a PC
key.where: top navigation bar
key.why: Text that wraps inside a menu looks broken to anyone; looks drive trust (behaviour guide 1.6).

key.flag: The site has a public page listing its own changes, which does not help a reader decide anything about money.
key.his_words: are we sure we need the changelog in the site?
key.where: the whole page, and its link in the menu
key.why: Readers ignore such a page rather than trip on it; keeping it or not is an owner's choice.

key.flag: Beside the heading of the common-questions block sits a tag 'בחירה של האתר' that nothing explains: chosen how, and for what.
key.his_words: what is this "בחירה של האתר" next to it?
key.where: the heading 'השאלות שכולם שואלים' on the rules page
key.why: An unexplained label next to a heading; any reader asks what it means.

key.flag: The rules section opens with a list of common questions and splits the rules over separate shelf pages; there is no single list of all rules, and how the front page differs from the shelves is unclear.
key.his_words: why is there no "all rules" link ... what is the difference between /rules and /rules/access?; the FAQ is first in the page and doesnt fit well ... the rules page should be ... the entire ruleset with quality of life filters
key.where: the rules front page and a shelf page
key.why: People look for the one place that lists everything and lose the scent when content is split (behaviour guide 1.3).

page: /goal/compare (a saved goal: a lump sum for 8 years, a 7% return entered)

key.flag: The goal comparison puts a kupat gemel lehashkaa first (or level with a securities account) although its own figures show a securities account at a cheaper broker would leave more money; the account is priced at one bank's tariff, so the pick misleads.
key.his_words: But if i invest through interactive israel for example? Wouldnt that result in more money?; you are saying investing through psagot is [more] ... why doesnt the site recommend psagot trade?; we have a problem here. this is misleading
key.where: the recommendation at the top of the comparison and the securities-account card
key.why: A recommendation that its own numbers contradict; a reader who compares the figures sees it.

key.flag: In the chart of fees over time, every fee kind in the legend and the bands has nearly the same orange colour, so the kinds cannot be told apart.
key.his_words: this is bad ui. every legend item has the same color; why use similar colors
key.where: the fee-over-time chart and its legend
key.why: Colours of one family cannot be matched to a legend (behaviour guide 1.4: legends cost back-and-forth; shade is read least well).

key.flag: In the home question card the three fields are not aligned: the years field sits lower because its label runs to two lines.
key.his_words: this is misaligned
key.where: the three fields of the question card
key.why: A visible misalignment in the first card of the site; looks drive trust.

key.flag: The saved goals sit side by side, but their move buttons are up and down arrows that move a goal left or right.
key.his_words: There is an up and down arrow but it moves left-right.
key.where: the row of saved goals at the top
key.why: An arrow that points one way and moves another breaks the most basic expectation of a control.

key.flag: There is no visible way to delete or rename a saved goal.
key.his_words: There is no delete button. ... No rename button
key.where: the row of saved goals at the top
key.why: People expect to manage what they saved; a missing delete is a standard usability finding.

key.flag: Of the purpose buttons in the question card ('בשביל מה'), only 'כרית ביטחון' changes anything; the others look like choices but change nothing on the page.
key.his_words: What is the "בשביל מה" field for? The only button which changes something is the "כרית ביטחון", the rest don't seem to change anything in the site.
key.where: the 'בשביל מה' buttons in the home question card
key.why: A control that changes nothing; people spend clicks only where a label promises something (behaviour guide 1.3).

key.flag: Pressing 'כרית ביטחון' removes the 'how many years' field above the buttons, so everything below jumps up under the pointer.
key.his_words: When clicked, it removes the "כמה שנים עד שתצטרכו את הכסף" field and consequently moves the entire screen up, disorienting the user.
key.where: the question card, between the two states
key.why: Content that moves under the pointer after a click disorients anyone.

key.flag: The home page shows the current goal as a card and the other saved goals only as small chips; he wanted every goal shown alike, one per row.
key.his_words: maybe the different goals show be displayed each in a row? like the Doron one but for all of them
key.where: the saved-goals block at the top of the home page
key.why: A layout preference; nothing on the screen is wrong.

key.flag: For someone who wants to put a sum and a monthly amount into the S&P 500, the site does not lay out the choices: which broker, then a foreign ETF or an Israeli fund, an ETF or a mutual fund, and which fund house.
key.his_words: Does the site help me understand whats the best method of doing so? because there are many different ways to go about it.
key.where: the index page as a whole
key.why: It is the core question of anyone who opens an index page; the answer is not there.

key.flag: The current-account guide shows a growth chart of money invested at a 10% yearly return, which has nothing to do with a current account.
key.his_words: That graph has nothing to do with the page there, no?
key.where: the chart 'מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן' in the guide
key.why: A chart whose subject is not the page's subject; a reader sees the mismatch.

key.his_words: why do you use Leumi numbers? what does this have to do with them?; the expanded graph is still very specific to leumi and one specific user's case
key.where: the interest lines and the expanded chart
key.why: One company's offer presented as the general case misleads any reader who notices the bank's name.

key.flag: In the management-fee card, the word 'שווה' is not lined up with its amount, and a stray dot sits alone on a line.
key.his_words: שווה is misaligned from its value. there is a random dot there?
key.where: the 'אם יורידו ל' saving lines of the fee card
key.why: Visible misalignment and a stray character look broken.

key.flag: The block 'מה להגיד בשיחה' (a script for calling the fund) is open by default, a long block most readers do not need.
key.his_words: make the "מה להגיד בשיחה" collapsed by default
key.where: the 'מה להגיד בשיחה' block in the fee card
key.why: Whether it starts open is a preference; people read little of such blocks either way.

key.flag: The 'הבחירה שלכם' line stands apart from the index chips; he wanted it beside 'המדד', smaller, in the same add-rename-move pill style as the goal page.
key.his_words: The "הבחירה שלכם" line maybe should be placed next to "המדד" but smaller in a nice way.
key.where: the index chips and the line under them
key.why: A placement preference and a wish for consistency with another page.

key.flag: The index page shows the plan's amounts (today, monthly, years, return, inflation) but none can be edited there, so a reader who only wants to compare where to buy an index cannot enter their own sums.
key.his_words: I cant edit anything in this index page. Someone may only need this site for this reason – comparing where to buy a specific index. So he should be able to input such values.
key.where: the plan figures under the index chips
key.why: Figures that look like inputs but cannot be changed; a reader with their own sums is stuck.

key.flag: The search box in the header is cut off: its placeholder text is clipped at the edge.
key.his_words: btw the search bar is clipping
key.where: the search box at the end of the top bar
key.why: Clipped text looks broken.

key.flag: Each fund's own fee figures carry an amber caution mark ('לפי החברה'), which reads as if data were missing or doubtful, though a fund manager's figure for its own fund is the official one.
key.his_words: in this case, we know that we are talking about a "fact" of a specific broker. so we dont need to have a "warning" there. a warning seems like we have incomplete data
key.where: the fee figures under every fund row
key.why: A warning colour on ordinary figures makes every reader doubt them.

key.flag: The fund fee parts are labelled only 'קבועים', 'משתנים', 'נאמן', which do not say they are fees.
key.his_words: also the "קבועים" "משתנים" "נאמן isnt clear that its talking about fees that much
key.where: the fee line under every fund row
key.why: Bare words without their noun; a reader has to guess what they measure.

key.where: the link on the home page and where it leads
key.why: The words promise more than the destination gives (information scent, behaviour guide 1.3).

key.his_words: the site still has separate makams in the guide

key.flag: Makam is listed under 'מוצרים' (products) though it is something bought inside an account, not a product of its own.
key.his_words: why under מוצרים? isnt it an exposure, not a wrapper?
key.where: the group the makam entry sits in
key.why: A wrong category; only a reader who knows what makam is would see it.

key.flag: The option 'חייב להיות ניתן למשיכה בכל רגע' on the index page seems to change nothing, so what it means there is unclear.
key.his_words: is there a meaning to setting the option "חייב להיות ניתן למשיכה בכל רגע"?
key.where: the option and the page around it, between the two states
key.why: A control with no visible effect.

key.flag: The table at the bottom of the index page changes its column widths when the inputs change, so the table jumps.
key.his_words: make the table at the bottom a fixed width for each column no matter what changes
key.where: the table at the bottom, between the two states
key.why: A table that reflows when a number changes makes figures hard to follow.

key.flag: The index page has a field for the pension fund's insurance fee as a share of deposits, which has nothing to do with investing in an index.
key.his_words: does the field "דמי הביטוח בקרן הפנסיה, כאחוז מההפקדות" matter to the indices page?
key.where: the assumptions fields
key.why: A field that belongs to another subject; people ask why they are being asked.

key.flag: Some funds are shown earning more each year than the index they track, and the currency-hedged ones less, with nothing explaining how.
key.his_words: how are they achieving a higher yearly return than the index they are tracking? and why do hedged ones make less than the index?
key.where: the funds' yearly-return figures against the index
key.why: Numbers that look impossible need an explanation beside them.

key.flag: The dollar scenario shows the dollar falling 3% every year for 12 years as a case to plan on, which is detached from reality.
key.his_words: displaying a -3% USD decline over 12 years is detached from reality no? like we say worst case -3% a year for 12 years. im not sure this is interesting here
key.where: the dollar scenario in the hedging part
key.why: A scenario that a reader with any sense of exchange rates finds implausible.

key.flag: A 'הצגת/הסתרת החוקים והכללים' button is repeated on sections across the site, and on some sections pressing it changes nothing because there are no rules there.
key.his_words: the הסתרת החוקים והכללים is a label button across the site ... some of these sections make no change when clicked, because there arent any חוקים וכללים relevant
key.where: the show/hide rules buttons on the page's sections
key.why: Repeated controls, some of which do nothing.

key.flag: The page of questions everyone asks, each with a one-line answer, adds little on its own.
key.his_words: The השאלות שכולם שואלים page isnt that useful.
key.where: the whole page
key.why: Whether a FAQ page earns its place is the owner's judgement.

key.flag: In the guide list, 'general track' is listed among the exposures (kinds of investment), which does not make sense: it is a mix, not one kind.
key.his_words: general-track is on the guides page and is considered an exposure. This doesnt make a lot of sense.
key.where: the exposures group of the guide list
key.why: A wrong category; a reader who knows tracks sees it.

key.flag: The visual 'עם נטרול מט״ח או בלי: לפי מה שיקרה לדולר' suggests a conclusion about hedged against unhedged funds that the data cannot support, and it sits near the top of the page instead of at the bottom.
key.his_words: something about how the page treats hedged vs unhedged funds is misleading ... its the "עם נטרול מט״ח או בלי: לפי מה שיקרה לדולר" visualization that i think is misleading. Also it should be at the bottom not the top
key.where: the hedged-or-not visual
key.why: A chart that reads as a forecast misleads; whether it sits at the bottom is his preference.

key.flag: Notes like 'לידיעתכם: מטבע USD' under foreign funds add nothing the reader needs.
key.his_words: A notice "לידיעתכם: מטבע USD" for USD funds - no need for this
key.where: the notes under the index heading and under foreign funds
key.why: Text that adds nothing is skipped and dilutes what matters (behaviour guide 1.1).

key.flag: The dollar exchange rate is shown even where the funds are bought in shekels on the Tel Aviv exchange, where it does not matter to the reader.
key.his_words: exchange rates shown for Tel Aviv funds
key.where: the exchange-rate line
key.why: Irrelevant figures beside relevant ones.

key.flag: The fund-kind labels carry whole explanations ('קרן סל: נסחרת כל היום', 'קרן מחקה: פעם ביום') instead of the short term alone.
key.his_words: labels "קרן סל: נסחרת כל היום" and "קרן מחקה: פעם ביום" - leave just the terms alone
key.where: the labels on the fund rows
key.why: Label length is a preference; both forms are readable.

key.flag: The sections and the sliders are spread out with large empty gaps, so the page is longer than it needs to be.
key.his_words: compact spaces between sections and compact the input sliders
key.where: spacing between sections and around the sliders
key.why: Density is a preference.

key.flag: The page says 13 accounts are not computed with the chosen fund and lists them, leaving much of the market out of the comparison.
key.his_words: The indices page says: 13 חשבונות לא מחושבים עם הקרן הזו ... We should fix those
key.where: the note listing the accounts not computed
key.why: A comparison that leaves out most options fails its purpose.

key.flag: A foreign fund (IE00B5BMR087) is labelled as needing self-reporting for tax, which holds at a foreign broker but not when bought through an Israeli bank or house.
key.his_words: The site says IE00B5BMR087 is דיווח עצמי למס, is this true? Through interactive brokers i agree, but israeli banks/investment houses?
key.where: the label on that fund's row
key.why: A wrong tax label; only a reader who knows the tax rule would see it.

key.flag: The bank-deposit guide asks for age, linkage and term, but those fields do not change its graph.
key.his_words: does the age, הצמדה, and תקופה matter?
key.where: the input fields beside the graph
key.why: Fields the page never uses waste the reader's effort.

key.flag: The guide home has sections that say nothing useful ('שני חלקים בכל חיסכון', 'מאיפה להתחיל').
key.his_words: The base guides page ... have useless sections: שני חלקים בכל חיסכון, מאיפה להתחיל.
key.where: the sections above or below the list of guides
key.why: Filler text; people read about a fifth of the words and resent the rest (behaviour guide 1.1).

key.flag: The current-account guide carries template sections that do not fit it (who offers it, money in and out, tax and the like), padding the page.

key.where: the sections 'who', 'in and out', 'tax' of the guide
key.why: Sections with nothing to say for this product.
